desc: Bowler Hat: a round black bowler hat with a short curled brim and a thin silk band, very proper
Straw Boater: a flat-topped stiff straw boater hat with a wide dark green and gold striped club ribbon
Smoking Cap: a round burgundy velvet gentleman's lounging cap with gold embroidery and a long gold tassel hanging from the top
Commodore's Cap: a white yacht club captain's cap with a black glossy peak, gold braid and a gold anchor badge
Chandelier Crown: a small sparkling crystal chandelier worn as a crown, gold arms with lit candles and dangling crystal drops
Tennis Whites: a white tennis polo with a cream cable-knit sweater draped over the shoulders, its sleeves tied loosely at the chest
Smoking Jacket: a burgundy velvet smoking jacket with black quilted satin lapels and cuffs, a tied sash belt, a silk cravat at the neck
Yacht Club Blazer: a navy and white striped regatta blazer with gold buttons and an anchor crest on the pocket, a white shirt
Tuxedo: a black dinner tuxedo with satin lapels, a crisp white pleated shirt, a black bow tie and a red carnation in the buttonhole
Founder's Robe: a heavy royal purple velvet robe with a white ermine fur collar with black spots, gold embroidered club crest on the chest and a gold chain of office
Champagne Flute: a tall crystal champagne flute full of bubbly golden champagne, held up for a toast, its pinky out
Tennis Racket: an old wooden tennis racket with white strings, resting on the shoulder

Pocket Watch Chain: a chunky gold watch chain worn across the chest, hooked to a button and looping down, a big round gold pocket watch dangling from it with its lid open. Bold dark outlines, chunky simple shapes, painterly - NOT realistic
Service Bell: a small polished brass hotel service bell worn on top of the head as a hat, a soft glow on it. Soft painted look exactly like the examples, no outlines

Pampered Poodle: a SMALL fluffy white poodle with a pink bow, fast asleep with its eyes closed and its nose still a little in the air, curled up perched on the ogre's shoulder like the frog and the parrot. Soft painted look exactly like the examples, no outlines
Golden Club Key: a giant ornate golden key to the club, as long as an arm, jewels on its bow, held up proudly
